description: Returns an UNSIGNED transaction {chainId, to, data, value} plus `simulation` — an eth_call of exactly it from `from` (ok, or the revert decoded by name) — `warnings` and `next`. This server signs nothing: the sender signs and sends it with their own wallet and pays the gas. Owner only. Moves idle balance (not in a position) out of the manager to `recipient`, one row per token, through the owner escape hatch `executeEncodedTxBatch`. Liquidity inside positions is withdrawn in the app's Withdraw page, which plans it against live prices.

chainId.description: EVM chain id: 8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 130 Unichain (1 = Ethereum mainnet, your gas)

from.description: The address that will send the transaction — the manager owner (ownerOf(1)). The simulation runs from it.

items.description: Idle balances to take out, one row per token

amount.description: Raw base units as a decimal string (USDC 1.5 = "1500000"), never a decimal

name: prepare_withdraw
title: Owner tx: withdraw idle funds
